description: This file defines the `ReminderService` class, which manages CRUD operations for reminders and delegates scheduling notifications to the `NotificationsManager`. It includes methods for listing, creating, updating, deleting reminders, and scheduling notifications with predefined messages based on reminder types.

classes.name: ReminderService
classes.description: A service class responsible for managing reminders and coordinating notifications, including creating, updating, deleting, and ensuring notification channels.

methods.name: ensureChannels
methods.description: Ensures that OS notification channels are set up before scheduling reminders.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves all reminders from the repository.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Creates or updates a reminder and schedules or cancels notifications accordingly.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a reminder and cancels any scheduled notification for it.

methods.name: scheduleForReminder
methods.description: Schedules a notification based on the reminder's details and type.
